# AraminConsole

> AraminConsole — an open-source, zero-dependency admin panel UI/UX framework. RTL-first, responsive, dark mode, app-like on mobile. Version 0.1.0. MIT licensed. Live demo: https://araminco.github.io/AraminConsole/demo/

Use one CSS file and one ES module (copy `dist/`). Components start from `data-ac="name"` attributes and have APIs on `window.AC`. Styling uses `--ac-*` design tokens and CSS logical properties. Powered by AIR (https://air.co.ir/).

## Start here
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole/main/README.md): Overview, quick start, module matrix
- [AGENTS.md — AraminConsole operating guide for AI coding assistants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole/main/AGENTS.md): Operating guide for AI coding assistants: architecture, conventions, commands
- [AraminConsole skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole/main/skills/aramin-console/SKILL.md): Agent Skill: component cheat-sheet and recipes for building admin panels
